info.title: ResearchBridge API
info.description: Production-grade backend for ResearchBridge — connecting university students with supervising professors, research publications, openings, and Gemini AI research assistant.

get.description: Health check endpoint. Returns operational status without revealing sensitive secrets.
Readiness probe for Railway or deployment container orchestrator.

Returns current authenticated session and profile details.
Identity is strictly derived from the verified Supabase Bearer token.
Returns current user's profile.

patch.description:
Updates the current user's profile.
Critical Security Rule:
A request body can never modify role, email, or account_status directly.

post.description: Completes onboarding for a newly registered student.

Submits an application for professor account status.
Remains unprivileged ('pending') until reviewed and approved by an administrator.

get.description: Lists active universities and research institutions.

schema.title: Response List Institutions Api V1 Institutions Get

get.description: Lists academic departments.

schema.title: Response List Departments Api V1 Departments Get

get.description: Returns the global research interest taxonomy.

schema.title: Response List Research Interests Api V1 Research Interests Get

get.description: Search and discover professors with filtering across institution, department, research topics, and capacity.

parameters.name: search

schema.description: Search across name, bio, or research interests
schema.title: Search

parameters.description: Search across name, bio, or research interests

get.description: Returns aggregated dashboard metrics for the authenticated professor.
Retrieves full public academic details for a specific professor.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated professor's supervision details and availability.

get.description: Lists publications authored by a professor, filtered by visibility permissions.

schema.title: Response List Professor Publications Api V1 Professors  Professor Id  Publications Get

post.description: Creates a new research publication record. Only authorized professors may author publications.

patch.description: Updates an existing publication. Enforces ownership: only author or admin.

delete.description: Deletes a publication. Enforces ownership: only author or admin.

get.description: Lists research projects available to students, with department, arrangement, and status filters.

post.description: Creates a new research project and advertised openings.

get.description: Lists all research projects managed by the authenticated professor.

schema.title: Response List My Research Projects Api V1 Professors Me Research Projects Get

get.description: Retrieves full details of a specific research project.

patch.description: Updates a research project. Enforces ownership: only supervising professor or admin.

schema.title: Response List Research Requests Api V1 Research Requests Get

post.description:
Submits a research collaboration application from student to professor.
Enforces uniqueness: no duplicate active applications to same professor & project.

get.description:
Retrieves a single research request and its status audit history.
Enforces authorization: only student applicant, target professor, or admin.

post.description: Accepts a student's research application. Only target professor or admin.
Rejects a research application. Only target professor or admin.
Requests additional details from the applicant.
Allows a student to withdraw their active application.

get.description:
Lists paginated messages in a request thread.
Enforces authorization: only participants or admin.

post.description:
Sends a message within a research request thread.
Enforces authorization: sender must be student applicant or target professor.
Marks all unread incoming messages in this request thread as read.

get.description: Lists documents accessible to the current user (owned, public, or institution-scoped).

schema.title: Response List Documents Api V1 Documents Get

post.description:
Uploads and validates a research document PDF.
Validates magic bytes, enforces max 20MB limit, hashes SHA-256.

get.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific document after verifying access.

delete.description: Deletes an uploaded document and removes associated storage.

get.description: Generates a secure, expiring download URL for an authorized document.

post.description:
Analyzes an uploaded research PDF using Google Gemini and produces a 15-part structured summary.
Checks and caches summary to avoid redundant provider costs.

get.description: Returns the cached summary for an authorized document.

post.description:
Contextual chat with the Gemini AI Research Assistant.
Supports optional conversation ID and optional document context.

get.description: Lists the current user's past AI assistant conversations.

schema.title: Response List Conversations Api V1 Ai Conversations Get

get.description: Retrieves full chat message history for an AI conversation.

post.description: Appends a new turn to an existing conversation thread.

get.description:
Computes explainable professor recommendations for the authenticated student
based on overlapping research interests, department alignment, and active availability.

schema.title: Response Get Professor Recommendations Api V1 Recommendations Professors Get

get.description: Computes explainable research project openings matching the student's prerequisite skills.

schema.title: Response Get Project Recommendations Api V1 Recommendations Projects Get

get.description: Retrieves all notifications for the authenticated user.

schema.title: Response List Notifications Api V1 Notifications Get

post.description:
Marks a specific notification as read.
Users cannot modify other users' notifications.
Marks all notifications for the current user as read.

get.description: Lists pending onboarding requests from professors awaiting credential verification.

schema.title: Response List Pending Professor Requests Api V1 Admin Professors Pending Get

post.description: Approves a professor onboarding request and elevates user's role to 'professor'.
Rejects a professor onboarding request.
Registers a new university/institution.
Creates a new department under an existing institution.
Suspends a user account to revoke platform access.
Reactivates a suspended user account.

get.description: Lists administrative audit log records.

schema.title: Response List Audit Logs Api V1 Admin Audit Logs Get

get.description:
Feature 1: Recommends suitable students for a faculty project, explaining why
each person is a match, missing skills, supporting project evidence, and alternatives.

post.description: Feature 2: Adds a skill with an evidence trail (self-reported, project-supported, or document-backed).

get.description: Feature 2: Retrieves verified skill passport entries.

parameters.name: student_id

schema.description: Optional target student ID to view
schema.title: Student Id

parameters.description: Optional target student ID to view

schema.title: Response List My Skill Passport Api V1 Skills Passport Get

post.description: Feature 2: Allows verified faculty to review evidence and formally endorse a student's skill.

Feature 3: Assembles a multidisciplinary research team, displaying coverage score,
missing roles, and alternative candidate combinations.

get.description:
Feature 4: Analyzes what a student is missing for a target project and provides
a structured preparation path with beginner-friendly micro-tasks.
Feature 5: Lists open research ideas in the pipeline across disciplines.

schema.title: Response List Research Ideas Api V1 Pipeline Ideas Get

post.description: Feature 5: Faculty publish early-stage research ideas (not just finished descriptions).
Feature 5: Students propose solutions and apply to contribute to early-stage research ideas.
Feature 6: Logs assigned tasks, completed milestones, hours invested, and deliverables.

get.description:
Feature 6: Generates a verified contribution summary based on actual task records
that students can add to their academic portfolio.

Feature 7: Recommends students from other departments when their skills fit the project,
fostering interdisciplinary collaboration across the whole university.

Feature 8: Proactively identifies projects matching the student's demonstrated strengths
and latent potential, explaining why the opportunity suits them.

Feature 9: Generates visual network data connecting students, faculty, skills,
research interests, and projects for visual graph rendering.

Feature 10: Audits recommendation distribution to prevent opportunity monopolization,
monitoring candidate pool consideration, beginner openings, and department representation.

post.description:
Feature 11: Decomposes a research idea into assignable student work packages,
prerequisite skills, roles, and deliverables without requiring any new API keys.
